observations: body L1: «méridional–oriental» has a long dash (5.3 pt). The sixth configuration, μεσημβρινὸς λίψ, is a setting, named from the west wind like the third (on p. 284, «coucher du matin (du vent d'ouest)») and the ninth (L8), and the parallel of the fourth, «lever méridional oriental», asks for «méridional occidental» here; kept as printed.

body L1-L10: the Greek and Halma's French are set as printed; «l. d. s.» and «c. d. s.» are «lever du soir» and «coucher du soir». A speck stands after συμμεσουράνημα (L6); the r of «soir» (L7) prints broken.
body L11: the dash after «b)» measures 10.0 pt, that of «1–7» 5.4 pt.

body L14-L21: the dash before «Ptolemaeus» measures 10.0 pt; «108–113» and «1825–26» have long dashes (5.3 and 5.4 pt, the second joined to the figures on both sides). «Ptolemaeus», «Ptolemaeum», «Ptolemaei» and «Ideler» are letter-spaced.
body L23: a blot stands below the line to the right of «supputatur.»; it is not a sign.
body L24-L28: «Ptolemaeus» and «Ideler» are letter-spaced; «Ptolemaico» (L26-L27) is not.
body L31-L34: «Autolyci», «Qosṭā ibn Lūqā», «Thābit ibn Qurrah» and «Autolycus» are letter-spaced; «al–Battānī» (L32) is not, with a long dash (5.2 pt).

body L36-L37: al-Battānī's text (translation, p. 120, l. 1-7) gives 15° for the stars of the first magnitude and arcs growing in order to about one sign, 30°, for the least: 15° + 5 · 3° = 30°, the steps of 3° of L36. A heavy bracket opens Schiaparelli's addition, which continues on p. 286.
notes_left L1-L7: «Ptolé-mée», «Théon» and «Tannery» are letter-spaced; the x of «fixes» (L4) prints faint and broken, like an r; the dash before «Versio» measures 8.2 pt.

notes_right L3-L6: «Eudoxus» and «Tannery» are letter-spaced; the 3 of «173» is a flat-topped figure; «173-199» and «190-191» have hyphens (3.2 and 3.0 pt), and the dash before «Eudoxus» measures 7.4 pt. The rule between the two columns of the notes prints broken.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
